dateSemantics: The generated field is the historical token inventory origin date, not the current build time. Current source identity is declarationGraph.sha256; deterministic builds do not stamp wall-clock time.

json.note: Generated from tokens/*.css. Root grouped by category; theme/element scopes carry overrides only. Regenerate after any token change (see docs/conventions.md).

dtcg.$description: CyberSkill design tokens targeting the DTCG 2025.10 emitted-value profile. CSS custom-property names and exact CSS expressions are preserved; scope overrides and relative em values use documented com.cyberskill extensions. General reader conformance and live design-tool imports are not implied.

com.cyberskill.note: CSS remains authoritative. Scope maps are CSS-valued vendor extensions; use the CyberSkill adapter. Relative em numbers retain relativeUnit; cssScale converts percentage ratios. nativeFormat preserves established native representation.
